analogy.rationale: GAT (SLC6A1) is a GABA transporter expressed mainly in the CNS, and these cell lines are non-neuronal and barely express it, so GAT inhibitors should produce little transcriptional response. Other neurotransmitter transporter inhibitors (GABA uptake, NET, VMAT, DAT, SERT) are the closest mechanistic relatives but also act on transporters largely absent from these cells, so they too should give weak/no response.
